page_title: OSA 2-4 GIR | Osasuna v Girona 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+104' Jose Luis Munuera Montero shows a yellow card to Aitor Fernandez (Osasuna) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+9' That's it for today, Jose Luis Munuera Montero has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Johan Mojica (Osasuna).
90+5' This is a yellow card! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+4' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+3' The current number of corner kicks is 1:6.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' 2 - 4 Aleix Garcia (Girona) latches on to a power cross and strikes with a shot inside the left post.
90' Substitution. Lucas Torro makes way for Jon Moncayola (Osasuna).
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Torro (Osasuna) was quite harsh and Jose Luis Munuera Montero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' Substitution. Ivan Martin makes his way off the pitch and Portu (Girona) comes on as his replacement.
85' Michel has decided to substitute Artem Dovbyk and he is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
85' Yangel Herrera (Girona) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
83' The substitution has been made. Raul (Osasuna) has replaced Aimar Oroz.
83' Here comes a substitution. Ruben Pena is given a rest as he is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
83' A pass by Ruben Pena (Osasuna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
80' 2 - 3 Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
78' Aleix Garcia (Girona) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Chimy Avila as he is replaced by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna).
75' Here is a change. Moi Gomez is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
72' Arnau Martinez (Girona) has tested the patience of referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
71' 2 - 2 Goal! Miguel Gutierrez picks out Artem Dovbyk (Girona) with a perfect cross, and he has no problem to nod the ball into an empty net. It's 2:2.
70' A substitution has been made. Yan Couto goes off and Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) comes on.
70' Total attempts – 9:7.
67' A player from Girona commits a rough challenge. Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
64' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
62' Yan Couto (Girona) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
62' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
61' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
59' Looks like Moi Gomez (Osasuna) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
57' The game is interrupted as Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is flagged offside.

55' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Johan Mojica sends a superb cross into the box. Ante Budimir (Osasuna) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header low inside the right post, leaving Paulo Gazzaniga beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 2:1.
55' Some great controlled play and passing from Osasuna. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
53' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Luis Munuera Montero had an easy-decision to make.
50' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.
49' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
47' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Jose Luis Munuera Montero interrupts the game. One of the players from Girona won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:5.
42' Aleix Garcia (Girona) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
41' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
40' Jose Luis Munuera Montero shows a yellow card to Chimy Avila (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
39' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
37' Osasuna keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
36' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
33' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
32' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
30' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:3.
28' A player from Girona commits a rough challenge. Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
25' 1 - 1 Goal 1:1! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
23' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
22' A clumsy foul by Ivan Martin (Girona) and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle.
21' One of the players from Girona times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
19' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
16' 0 - 1 Goal! Artem Dovbyk passes the ball to the feet of Ivan Martin (Girona), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 0:1.
15' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Yangel Herrera (Girona) offside.
14' Wasted effort! Chimy Avila (Osasuna) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
13' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle after Yangel Herrera (Girona) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
12' 27:73 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
10' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Artem Dovbyk (Girona) heads on.
8' Arnau Martinez drives to the by-line and dinks a lovely cross into the middle of the box. Yangel Herrera (Girona) wins the ball but his header is just over the bar.
7' A spell of possession for Girona in an attempt to control the game.
5' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul after Moi Gomez (Osasuna) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
4' A quickly taken corner by Girona.
3' A lofted cross from Savio (Girona) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Girona.
1' The first half has started.
Girona will kick-off.
Jose Luis Munuera Montero is the one to supervise the game today.
